_comment: English message catalog (default). Keys are stable identifiers; {name} placeholders are filled by atlas/i18n.py (Python) and atlas/lib.sh (bash). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
jobs.stale_hours: {name}: log has not changed for {age}h (limit {limit}h) — the job may not have started at all
jobs.no_success: {name}: log is fresh but has no success confirmation (looking for: {pattern})
jobs.stale_minutes: {name}: log has not changed for {age} min (limit {limit}) — the job did not start
jobs.last_line_bad: {name}: the last run did not succeed ({line}) — check {file}
jobs.no_success_ever: {name}: no successful run in the log (looking for: {pattern})
jobs.success_too_old: {name}: the last SUCCESSFUL run was {age} min ago (limit {limit}) — skipped runs do not count
jobs.syntax: jobs.d/{file}: syntax error, contract not loaded
patrol.unknown_timeout: UNKNOWN: {name} — time limit of {limit} s exceeded
patrol.report_header: NEW REPORT ({bridge}) - to be sent to the human:
patrol.section_message: Patrol: new or changed alert section: {section}
atlas.certs_ssl_count_failed: certs: cannot count the SSL vhosts (reading sites-enabled failed)
atlas.certs_empty: certs: empty list while there are {count} SSL vhosts (certbot not answering?)
atlas.cert_unreadable: cert {name}: cannot read the expiry date ({error})
atlas.silent_failure: last run ENDED WITH AN ERROR ({when}); failures in 7 days: {count}
atlas.bless_refused: bless refused: the snapshot contains failed measurements (UNKNOWN):
atlas.measure_failed: ATLAS DOES NOT KNOW: a measurement failed, not comparing with the baseline:
atlas.show_disk: disk {used} used, {avail} free | RAM avail {mem}Mi | load {load} | bans {bans}
atlas.show_vhosts: vhosts: {vhosts} | ports: {ports} | accounts with a shell: {accounts}
ssh.no_known_list: cannot judge: known-IP list {path} is missing: {error}
ssh.login_line: successful SSH login from unknown IP {ip} as {user} ({method}), {when}
http.no_named_vhost: HTTP probes: no vhost with a ServerName in {dir}, nothing to probe (named vhosts not present)
esc.patrol_silent:
PATROL SILENT for {age} min (threshold {limit}). Last entry:
{last}
esc.patrol_missing: heartbeat.log MISSING — the patrol never started or someone deleted it.
esc.resident_dead:
RESIDENT DEAD: {signs}.
The machine runs, but nobody analyses the alerts.{revive}
esc.alert_unacked:
ALERT WITHOUT A RECIPIENT for {age} min — nobody acknowledged it. Content:
{body}
esc.stream_missing:
EVENT STREAM SILENT: file {file} is missing — the sentinel-stream daemon did not start or the file was deleted.
Check: systemctl status sentinel-stream
esc.stream_silent:
EVENT STREAM SILENT for {age} min (threshold {limit}). The sentinel-stream daemon stopped beating.
Check: systemctl status sentinel-stream
esc.subject: [sentinel] SERVER needs attention ({kind})
stream.ssh_unknown: SSH login as {user} from an unknown address {ip}.
stream.oom: The kernel killed process {name} (out of memory).
stream.web_leak: Sensitive path {path} returned {status} with a non-empty body ({bytes} B) on {vhost} - possible leak.
stream.source_unreadable: Stream sensor '{source}' has not read its source for over {seconds} s - silence is not health.
router.subject: [sentinel] critical: {what}
atlas.no_baseline: no baseline yet — review `atlas.py show` and run `bless`
atlas.ack_nothing: nothing to acknowledge: there is no ALERT
atlas.ack_raced: ALERT changed while it was being acknowledged; read it again and acknowledge the new content
atlas.notify_not_sent: the human was not notified now ({status}); the escalation timer retries from the outbox
esc.unsafe_state: The runtime directory {dir} is not safe ({reason}): escalation cannot keep its markers and log there and stops after this mail. Fix its owner and mode (owned by the Atlas user, not group- or other-writable, not a symlink) or remove it. This mail repeats every {hours} h.
router.wake_limit_subject: [sentinel] too many agent wake-ups: limit {limit}/h reached
router.wake_limit_body: More than {limit} alert events would have woken the agent within one hour (first suppressed: {sensor}). The agent gets one summary line when the hour ends; look at the bus (events.jsonl) yourself.
digest.subject: [sentinel] daily digest: {count} agent action(s)
digest.header: Agent sudo, baseline acceptances, acknowledgements and rejected forged sudo lines from {since} to {until} (UTC):
